name: GraphSense
tagline: Upload a dataset and three agents analyse it, recommend charts and justify each choice.

awards: [Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash

problem: Making good charts takes expertise and time.
solution: A three-agent pipeline profiles the data, recommends from ten chart types with confidence scores and validates each with reasoning.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a CSV and get ranked chart suggestions.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash” among 112 submissions.
Explains why each chart fits, as the sponsor asked.

lessons: Justify the recommendation; the reasoning is the product.
